scholarships.name: HEC Overseas Scholarships for MS/MPhil & PhD
scholarships.coverageDetail: Pakistan's long-running overseas scholarship scheme for MS/MPhil and PhD study abroad; awards have historically covered tuition and a monthly living stipend, with the exact package set by each cycle's advertisement
eligibility: Pakistani or AJK nationals holding the academic credentials required for the advertised level
Sixteen years of education for the MS/MPhil stream or eighteen years for the PhD stream from an HEC-recognised institution
Must satisfy the merit, field, and age criteria announced in each cycle's advertisement
scholarships.deadline: Batches are advertised periodically on HEC's website and portal; check scholarship.hec.gov.pk for the current cycle's closing date (approx.)
howToApply: Watch hec.gov.pk and HEC's scholarship portal for the next overseas scholarship advertisement
Register and submit the application through HEC's online portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk) within the advertised window

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships (via HEC)
scholarships.funder: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (FCDO), with HEC Pakistan as nominating agency
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition at a UK university, a monthly living stipend, return airfare from Pakistan, and other allowances for a one-year taught master's degree
eligibility: Pakistani citizens nominated through HEC Pakistan, the designated nominating agency, which has around 26 master's nominations per cycle
A bachelor's degree equivalent to a UK upper second-class honours (2:1) result
Genuine financial need, meaning the candidate cannot afford UK study without the scholarship
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically open in early September and close in mid-to-late October, after HEC's earlier nomination window (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for HEC nomination through HEC's online scholarship portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk) when the Commonwealth advertisement appears
Shortlisted candidates then complete the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission's online application before the CSC deadline

scholarships.name: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships (via HEC)
scholarships.funder: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (FCDO), with HEC Pakistan as nominating agency
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition at a UK university, a monthly stipend for the doctoral period, return airfare from Pakistan, and research-related allowances
eligibility: Pakistani citizens nominated by HEC Pakistan, which handles around 30 General PhD nominations per cycle
Qualifications sufficient for doctoral study, typically an upper second-class honours degree or a master's
A research proposal with strong development relevance for Pakistan
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically open in early September and close in mid-to-late October for the following year (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for HEC nomination through HEC's online scholarship portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk) when the advertisement appears
Shortlisted candidates then complete the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission's online application before the CSC deadline

scholarships.name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship Programme
scholarships.funder: Government of Hungary (Tempus Public Foundation), with HEC Pakistan as sending partner
scholarships.coverageDetail: Tuition exemption, a dormitory place or housing contribution, a monthly stipend, and medical insurance for bachelor's, master's, or doctoral study in Hungary
eligibility: Pakistani citizens applying through HEC Pakistan, the designated sending partner for the programme
Applications must be submitted on both the Stipendium Hungaricum portal and HEC's portal by the deadline
Must meet the admission requirements of the chosen Hungarian higher education institutions
scholarships.deadline: The 2026/27 round closed on 15 January 2026 at 16:00 PST; expect a similar mid-January deadline each year (approx.)
howToApply: Submit the application on the Stipendium Hungaricum portal (stipendiumhungaricum.hu), listing the chosen Hungarian programmes
Register and apply in parallel on HEC's scholarship portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk) so HEC can nominate you

scholarships.name: Chinese Government Scholarship Program via HEC (CGSP)
scholarships.funder: China Scholarship Council, with HEC Pakistan as nominating agency
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition, on-campus accommodation, a monthly living stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance at Chinese universities, with roughly 35 bachelor's, 25 master's, and 15 PhD seats for Pakistani nominees per cycle
eligibility: Pakistani or AJK nationals applying through HEC's nomination channel for Type-A Chinese Government Scholarship places
Completed higher secondary education (HSSC or equivalent) for bachelor's, sixteen years of education for master's, and an MS/MPhil for PhD, with PhD candidates typically under 40
Must meet the age and academic requirements published in HEC's annual CGSP advertisement
scholarships.deadline: The 2026-27 HEC application window closed in early January 2026; expect a similar turn-of-the-year deadline in future cycles (approx.)
howToApply: Apply through HEC's online scholarship portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk) before HEC's deadline
Nominated candidates then complete the China Scholarship Council application on campuschina.org with HEC's agency number

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Split-site Scholarships (via HEC)
scholarships.funder: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (FCDO), with HEC Pakistan nomination
scholarships.coverageDetail: Twelve months of fully funded research at a UK university while remaining registered for a PhD in Pakistan, including a monthly stipend, return airfare, and study-related allowances
eligibility: Pakistani PhD students registered at an HEC-recognised university in Pakistan
A twelve-month research plan supported by supervisors at both the home and UK institutions
Pakistani applicants are typically routed through HEC Pakistan, the country's Commonwealth nominating agency
scholarships.deadline: The call runs once a year through the CSC's online system; check cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk for current opening and closing dates (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for HEC nomination through HEC's scholarship portal when the split-site call is announced
Complete the Commonwealth Scholarship Commission's online application with the UK supervisor's supporting documents

scholarships.name: US-Pakistan Knowledge Corridor PhD Scholarships
scholarships.coverageDetail: Funding of up to about USD 19,200 per year for up to five years of PhD study at top QS-ranked US universities, broadly the top 300
eligibility: Pakistani nationals with eighteen years of education (MS/MPhil or equivalent) in the programme's priority subject areas
Must secure admission to a PhD programme at an approved top QS-ranked US university
Scholars commit to returning to serve Pakistani universities after completing the doctorate
scholarships.deadline: Applications for 2027 admissions close around 30 October 2026 (Spring/Summer 2027 intake) and 30 March 2027 (Fall 2027 intake) (approx.)
howToApply: Log in to HEC's e-portal, open 'Scholarships and Grants', and submit the US-PAK Knowledge Corridor application form
Complete HEC's screening, including the HAT aptitude test, and secure PhD admission at an approved US university

scholarships.name: International Research Support Initiative Program (IRSIP)
scholarships.coverageDetail: A six-month fully funded research fellowship at a foreign university, covering the Pakistani PhD scholar's living and visit costs during the placement
eligibility: Full-time PhD students enrolled at an HEC-recognised university in Pakistan
A six-month research placement at a foreign university relevant to the scholar's thesis
Nomination and approval by the scholar's home university and supervisor
scholarships.deadline: Batches open periodically through the year; watch HEC's scholarship portal for the next call (approx.)
howToApply: Apply online through HEC's scholarship portal (scholarship.hec.gov.pk) when a batch is open
Secure an acceptance letter from a foreign university supervisor before the application deadline

scholarships.name: ASEA-UNINET PhD Scholarships for Pakistan
scholarships.funder: HEC Pakistan and Austria's OeAD through the ASEA-UNINET network
scholarships.coverageDetail: An HEC-financed doctoral scholarship administered by Austria's OeAD, funding up to 36 months of PhD study in Austria with the possibility of a fourth-year extension
eligibility: Pakistani citizens who have completed a master's degree
Admission or an invitation from an ASEA-UNINET member university in Austria
Candidates pass HEC's pre-selection stage before ASEA-UNINET's academic review
scholarships.deadline: One closing date per year, typically in spring; check asea-uninet.org and HEC announcements for the exact date (approx.)
howToApply: Prepare the ASEA-UNINET scholarship application with supporting documents from the Austrian host university
Complete HEC Pakistan's parallel application and pass its pre-selection process

scholarships.name: Fulbright Degree Program for Pakistan
scholarships.funder: U.S. Department of State, administered by the United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition and fees, textbooks, airfare, a monthly living stipend, and health insurance for master's or PhD study at US universities
eligibility: Pakistani citizens with sixteen years of education for a master's and eighteen years for a PhD
GRE general test scores are required, with a stated minimum of 145 in each section
All fields are eligible except clinical medicine, and PhD grantees sign a bond to return and serve in Pakistan
scholarships.deadline: The application window typically closes around 1 April each year for the following year's intake (approx.)
howToApply: Create an account and complete the online application at usefp.org
Take the GRE general test and submit transcripts, references, and a study objective online before the deadline

scholarships.name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program (Pakistan)
scholarships.funder: U.S. Department of State, administered by the United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Ten to twelve months of non-degree graduate-level study and professional development in the US, covering tuition and fees, airfare, textbooks, a monthly stipend, and health insurance
eligibility: Pakistani citizens with sixteen years of education, such as a four-year bachelor's degree
Eight to eighteen years of progressively responsible professional work experience
A guarantee of re-employment in Pakistan and demonstrated leadership qualities
scholarships.deadline: The application window typically closes around mid-to-late May each year for the following year's fellowship (approx.)
howToApply: Complete the online application at usefp.org during the open window
Submit employer documents, references, and English proficiency evidence with the application

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition for a one-year taught master's at any UK university, a monthly living allowance, return flights to the UK, and arrival and departure allowances
eligibility: Pakistani citizens with an undergraduate degree and at least two years (2,800 hours) of work experience
Apply to three different eligible UK master's courses and hold at least one unconditional offer by mid-July
Commitment to return to Pakistan for two years after the scholarship ends
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically open in August and close in early November each year (approx.)
howToApply: Create an account and apply online at chevening.org, selecting three UK master's courses
Submit two references and secure an unconditional offer by the July deadline

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarships
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full participation costs (tuition), travel and installation allowances, and a monthly living allowance for a joint master's studied at universities in at least three different countries
eligibility: Open to students of any nationality, including Pakistanis, who hold a first-cycle (bachelor's) degree
Apply directly to the Erasmus Mundus consortium running the chosen joint master's programme
Only a limited number of scholarship seats are available per programme, awarded on academic merit
scholarships.deadline: Consortium applications typically open in October and close between December and February for the following academic year (approx.)
howToApply: Browse the Erasmus Mundus catalogue on the Erasmus+ website and shortlist joint master's programmes
Apply directly to each consortium following its own application instructions

scholarships.name: DAAD EPOS Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
scholarships.funder: German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD), funded by Germany's Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development
scholarships.coverageDetail: A monthly scholarship of about EUR 992 for master's and EUR 1,300 to 1,400 for doctoral candidates, plus travel, health insurance, and study allowances for development-related courses in Germany
eligibility: Graduates from eligible developing countries, including Pakistan, with at least two years of relevant professional experience
A bachelor's degree (usually four years) for master's courses and a master's degree for doctoral courses
Admission or pre-admission contact with the chosen EPOS course before applying
scholarships.deadline: Deadlines vary by course; many EPOS courses accept applications between August and October each year (approx.)
howToApply: Choose a development-related postgraduate course from the DAAD EPOS course list
Apply via the DAAD application portal or the course coordinator as instructed for that course

scholarships.name: Ernst Mach Grant (worldwide)
scholarships.funder: OeAD, funded by the Austrian Federal Ministry of Education, Science and Research
scholarships.coverageDetail: A monthly grant of about EUR 1,300 for one to nine months of research in Austria, plus accident and health insurance and a travel subsidy of up to EUR 1,200 depending on the applicant's country
eligibility: Researchers of any nationality except Austria, including Pakistanis, no older than 35 at the application deadline
An invitation or supervision agreement from an Austrian host institution
First-time recipients only; previous Ernst Mach Grant holders cannot apply again
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically run from September to 1 December each year for the following year (approx.)
howToApply: Secure an invitation or supervision confirmation from an Austrian host institution
Apply online through the OeAD grants portal (grants.at) within the application window

scholarships.name: Italian Government Scholarships (MAECI)
scholarships.funder: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
scholarships.coverageDetail: A monthly grant of EUR 900 for six to nine months, exemption from university tuition and enrolment fees at Italian state institutions, and health insurance cover while in Italy
eligibility: Foreign students from eligible countries, including Pakistan, who meet the entry requirements for the chosen Italian programme
Applications are submitted exclusively through the Study in Italy portal within the call window
Italian or English language proficiency as required by the chosen degree programme
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically open in late winter and close in late March; the 2026-27 call closed at 2:00 PM CET on 26 March 2026 (approx.)
howToApply: Register on the Study in Italy portal (studyin.it) and complete the online application during the call
Submit the required documents, including legalised qualifications and language certificates, per the call's instructions

scholarships.name: Global Korea Scholarship (Graduate)
scholarships.funder: Government of the Republic of Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Round-trip airfare, full tuition, a monthly allowance, settlement and Korean language training support, and medical insurance for master's or PhD study in Korea
eligibility: Pakistani citizens with a cumulative GPA of at least 80% (or equivalent) in the most recent degree
Under 40 years of age for graduate programme applicants
Embassy track applicants from Pakistan compete for a small quota (eight seats in the 2026 cycle), with the university track as an alternative route
scholarships.deadline: Embassy track applications typically run a short February window (12 to 25 February in the 2026 cycle); university track deadlines are set by each Korean university (approx.)
howToApply: Apply online through the Study in Korea portal (studyinkorea.go.kr), choosing the embassy or university track
Embassy track applicants submit documents to the Korean Embassy in Islamabad; university track applicants apply directly to the chosen university

scholarships.name: Global Korea Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.funder: Government of the Republic of Korea (NIIED, Ministry of Education)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Round-trip airfare, full tuition, a monthly allowance, settlement support, a year of Korean language training, and medical insurance for an undergraduate degree in Korea
eligibility: Pakistani citizens who have completed secondary school with strong academic results
Under 25 years of age at the time of application
Pakistan's embassy track quota is small (two general seats plus one regional track seat in the 2026 cycle)
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically run in the second half of September (15 to 30 September in the 2026 cycle) (approx.)
howToApply: Apply online through the Study in Korea portal (studyinkorea.go.kr) during the window, as the GKS-U is online-only
Prepare the required documents as specified in the annual GKS-U guidelines

scholarships.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
scholarships.funder: China Scholarship Council, Ministry of Education of China
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition, on-campus accommodation or a housing subsidy, a monthly living stipend of roughly RMB 2,500 to 3,500 depending on study level, and comprehensive medical insurance
eligibility: Pakistani citizens who are non-Chinese nationals in good health
Educational requirements per level: high school certificate for bachelor's, bachelor's for master's, and MS/MPhil for PhD
Apply through the Chinese embassy in Pakistan (Type A) or directly to a Chinese university (Type B)
scholarships.deadline: Application windows typically run from December to April for the September intake, depending on the track chosen (approx.)
howToApply: Create an account on the CSC portal (campuschina.org) and choose Type A (embassy) or Type B (university) application
Submit the printed application and documents to the Chinese embassy in Islamabad or to the chosen Chinese university

scholarships.name: Türkiye Bursları (Türkiye Scholarships)
scholarships.funder: Government of Türkiye (Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition, a monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance, a one-year Turkish language course, and round-trip airfare for degree study in Türkiye
eligibility: Pakistani citizens (foreign nationals generally) with the prior degree required for the chosen level
Age limits as of 1 January of the application year: under 21 for bachelor's, under 30 for master's, and under 35 for PhD
Minimum academic achievement of about 70% for bachelor's and 75% for graduate programmes
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically open in January and close in February for the following academic year (approx.)
howToApply: Create an account and apply online at turkiyeburslari.gov.tr, selecting up to twelve programme preferences
Shortlisted candidates attend an interview at the Turkish Embassy in Islamabad

scholarships.name: KNB Developing Countries Partnership Scholarship
scholarships.funder: Ministry of Higher Education, Science, and Technology of the Republic of Indonesia
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition, a monthly living allowance (about IDR 1,750,000 for bachelor's and IDR 2,550,000 for master's and PhD), settlement and book or research allowances, health insurance, round-trip airfare, and Indonesian language preparatory study
eligibility: Pakistani citizens (developing-country nationals) with the prior degree required for the chosen level
Age limits of 21 for bachelor's, 35 for master's, and 40 for PhD applicants
Study at one of the participating Indonesian universities with the required language preparatory training
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically open in early February and close at the end of March (approx.)
howToApply: Register and apply online through the KNB scholarship portal (knb.kemdiktisaintek.go.id)
Complete the document verification and interview stages after submission

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland Postgraduate Scholarship Programme
scholarships.funder: Research Ireland, funded by the Government of Ireland
scholarships.coverageDetail: A stipend of about EUR 22,000 per year, tuition fee contributions of up to EUR 5,750, and EUR 3,250 in direct research expenses for a research master's or doctorate at an eligible Irish institution
eligibility: Open to candidates of any nationality, including Pakistanis, holding a first-class or upper second-class honours primary degree
A developed research proposal and a supervisor at an eligible Irish higher education institution
Applications are made jointly by the candidate and supervisor before the autumn deadline
scholarships.deadline: The applicant deadline typically falls in October for awards starting the following year (approx.)
howToApply: Develop a research proposal with a supervisor at an eligible Irish institution
Submit the joint application through Research Ireland's online system before the call deadline

scholarships.name: NL Scholarship for Non-EEA Students
scholarships.funder: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science with participating Dutch universities
scholarships.coverageDetail: A one-time award of EUR 5,000 towards the first year of a bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch institution; it is not a full tuition award
eligibility: Pakistani citizens (non-EEA nationals) applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch institution
No previous study at a Dutch higher education institution
Must meet the entry requirements of the chosen programme and the institution's selection criteria
scholarships.deadline: The 2026-27 round opened in November 2025; participating institutions set their own deadlines, typically around 1 February (approx.)
howToApply: Choose a participating Dutch institution and a full-time programme
Apply for the NL Scholarship directly with the institution, following its posted instructions and deadline

scholarships.name: DAAD Helmut Schmidt Programme (Public Policy and Good Governance)
scholarships.funder: German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) with the German Federal Foreign Office
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full funding for a master's in public policy and good governance at one of eight participating German universities, including a monthly stipend, travel allowance, and insurance
eligibility: Graduates from the programme's eligible countries, which include Pakistan
A bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline with above-average results
A commitment to public service and governance in the home country after graduation
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically run from summer into early autumn for the following year's intake (approx.)
howToApply: Choose up to two of the eight participating master's programmes
Apply online through the DAAD application portal with transcripts, references, and proof of English proficiency

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.funder: Government of Ireland, administered by the Higher Education Authority (HEA)
scholarships.coverageDetail: A EUR 10,000 stipend for one study year plus a full tuition fee waiver for that year, for high-calibre non-EU students at Irish higher education institutions
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA candidates, including Pakistanis, who hold or are eligible for an offer from an Irish institution
Applying for a full-time programme of one year or more at a participating institution
An excellent academic record alongside extracurricular or community engagement
scholarships.deadline: The annual call typically closes in late March for the following academic year (approx.)
howToApply: Secure an offer or eligibility confirmation from a participating Irish institution
Submit the online GOI-IES application with references and transcripts through the HEA portal

scholarships.name: KAIST International Student Scholarship
scholarships.funder: KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition for the undergraduate programme plus a monthly living allowance of KRW 350,000, continued subject to KAIST's academic standards
eligibility: International applicants, including Pakistanis, applying through KAIST's international undergraduate admissions
Completion of, or enrollment in the final year of, high school in a recognised system
Strong academic preparation, particularly for KAIST's science and technology programmes
scholarships.deadline: KAIST runs annual international undergraduate admission rounds; check the admissions calendar on admission.kaist.ac.kr (approx.)
howToApply: Apply through KAIST's online international admissions system (admission.kaist.ac.kr)
Submit transcripts, teacher recommendations, a study plan, and English proficiency evidence

scholarships.name: Rhodes Scholarship (Pakistan Constituency)
scholarships.coverageDetail: All Oxford University course fees plus an annual living stipend of around GBP 19,000 (2025-26 rate) for two or more years of full-time postgraduate study at Oxford
eligibility: Pakistani citizens who are domiciled in Pakistan or have received a substantial part of their formal education in Pakistan, applying through the dedicated Pakistan constituency
Meet the constituency's age requirements, broadly between 19 and 25 on 1 October of entry, as published by the Rhodes Trust
Hold an undergraduate degree with outstanding academic results before taking up the scholarship
scholarships.deadline: The Pakistan constituency application window typically runs from June to early August for the following year's intake (approx.)
howToApply: Apply online through the Rhodes House application portal under the Pakistan constituency
Submit academic transcripts, a personal statement, references, and English proficiency evidence, and attend the constituency's interview process

scholarships.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
scholarships.funder: Gates Cambridge Trust, funded by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full University Composition Fee, a maintenance allowance of GBP 22,050 for twelve months (2025-26 rate, pro rata for shorter courses), one economy return airfare per year, and inbound visa and immigration health surcharge costs
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom, including Pakistan, applying for a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge
Outstanding intellectual ability and academic achievement in the chosen field
Demonstrated leadership potential and a commitment to improving the lives of others, the core Gates Cambridge selection criteria
scholarships.deadline: Applications open in September for the following academic year, with deadlines in December or January depending on the chosen course (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to a full-time postgraduate course at Cambridge through the university's applicant portal
Complete the Gates Cambridge section of the admission application, including references that address the scholarship's selection criteria

scholarships.name: Clarendon Fund Scholarships
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full course fees and college fees plus a generous annual living-expenses grant for the whole duration of the course, with around 140 new scholars each year
eligibility: Applicants of any nationality, including Pakistanis, who apply for an eligible graduate course at Oxford by the course deadline
Selection is based solely on academic merit and potential, assessed from the course application
No separate scholarship application exists; all timely course applicants are automatically considered
scholarships.deadline: Candidates must submit their Oxford graduate course application by the standard December or January course deadlines to be considered (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for an eligible full-time graduate course at Oxford through the university's online application system
Ensure the application, including references, is complete by the course deadline for automatic Clarendon consideration

scholarships.name: Schwarzman Scholars Programme
scholarships.funder: Schwarzman Scholars, hosted at Tsinghua University in Beijing
scholarships.coverageDetail: Tuition and fees, room and board, a personal stipend, health insurance, study trips, and travel to and from Beijing for the one-year master's in Global Affairs
eligibility: Applicants aged 18 to 28 at enrolment from any country, including Pakistan
An undergraduate degree completed by August of enrolment, with academic excellence, leadership ability, and civic engagement
English proficiency and a demonstrated interest in China and global affairs
scholarships.deadline: The global application round typically closes in mid-to-late September for the following year's cohort (approx.)
howToApply: Complete the online Schwarzman Scholars application with essays, transcripts, and recommendation letters
Shortlisted candidates advance to video and in-person finalist interviews before final selection

scholarships.name: SNU Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition exemption for up to four semesters plus a monthly living allowance of at least KRW 500,000, with eligibility varying by country and college each semester
eligibility: International applicants, including Pakistanis, whose combination of country and SNU college is on the GSFS eligibility list for the admission semester
Applicants to Seoul National University graduate programmes with excellent academic records
Selection is conducted by the individual SNU colleges and schools after the admission application
scholarships.deadline: Applications run with SNU's regular graduate admission rounds; check the semester's GSFS announcement and scholarship finder (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for SNU graduate admission online and tick the Application for Scholarship box during the application
Check your country and college eligibility in SNU's scholarship finder before applying

scholarships.name: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarships
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition fees per year plus a financial contribution towards living expenses for a two-year TU Delft MSc programme, with two scholarships awarded per faculty
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA students, including Pakistanis, applying for a TU Delft MSc programme, ranked roughly in the top 10% of their graduating class
A complete MSc application including two reference letters and proof of English proficiency
Selection is per faculty, with each faculty awarding two scholarships
scholarships.deadline: The scholarship form must be submitted with the MSc application by 1 December, with results announced around the end of March (approx.)
howToApply: Submit the TU Delft MSc application online with transcripts and English test scores
Complete the scholarship application form and upload two reference letters alongside the MSc application before the deadline

scholarships.name: Politecnico di Milano Merit-Based Scholarships
scholarships.coverageDetail: A full tuition-fee waiver for the whole programme, with recipients paying only an administrative fee of about EUR 170; Gold-tier awards additionally provide EUR 8,000 gross per year towards living costs
eligibility: Non-EU international applicants, including Pakistanis, admitted to a Laurea Magistrale (master's) programme at Politecnico di Milano
Application through the annual merit-based scholarship call published for the September intake
Selection is based on academic merit as assessed during the admission evaluation
scholarships.deadline: Scholarship calls are published annually with deadlines aligned to Politecnico di Milano's admission rounds; check the current call on the university's scholarships page (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to a Laurea Magistrale programme through Politecnico di Milano's online portal
Follow the annual scholarship call instructions and submit the scholarship request within the stated deadline

scholarships.name: University of Bologna Study Grants (Unibo Action 2)
scholarships.coverageDetail: A study grant of EUR 11,000 gross per year paid in instalments for first, single, or second cycle degree programmes; a separate Unibo Action 1 waiver exempts winners from tuition fees
eligibility: International applicants, including Pakistanis, admitted or applying to a degree programme at the University of Bologna
Applicants must be under 30 years of age at the deadline
Awards are made by ranking based on academic merit and other criteria set in the annual call
scholarships.deadline: Calls are published each year, typically with application deadlines between late March and April for the following academic year (approx.)
howToApply: Submit the application through the University of Bologna's online portal after applying for admission
Upload the required documents, including transcripts and any financial documentation requested in the call

scholarships.name: Koç University International Student Scholarships
scholarships.coverageDetail: Undergraduate merit awards ranging from 25% to 100% of tuition, while admitted graduate students typically receive a full tuition waiver and many programmes add a monthly stipend
eligibility: International applicants, including Pakistanis, applying to Koç University's undergraduate or graduate programmes
Undergraduate candidates submit SAT, ACT, or IB results, with scholarships awarded by admission merit ranking
Graduate applicants are evaluated for tuition waivers and stipends as part of the admission decision
scholarships.deadline: Applications follow Koç University's admission calendar, with international undergraduate rounds typically closing in summer (approx.)
howToApply: Apply online through Koç University's international admission portal for the chosen programme
Submit SAT/ACT/IB or graduate test results, transcripts, and English proficiency evidence; scholarship evaluation is automatic with admission

scholarships.name: Sabancı University Graduate Scholarships
scholarships.coverageDetail: A 100% tuition exemption for admitted graduate students; Full Scholarship holders also receive a monthly stipend (around TRY 43,500 for master's and TRY 67,500 for doctoral students in 2026-27), free dormitory accommodation, and private health insurance
eligibility: International applicants, including Pakistanis, admitted to Sabancı University's master's or PhD programmes
All admitted graduate students receive the tuition exemption, while full scholarships with stipends are awarded by admission merit ranking
Evaluation is performed automatically with the graduate admission application
scholarships.deadline: Graduate applications are reviewed in periodic admission rounds; check Sabancı University's graduate admissions calendar for each programme (approx.)
howToApply: Apply to a Sabancı University graduate programme online with transcripts, references, and English proficiency evidence
No separate scholarship form is required, as awards are evaluated during the admission process

scholarships.name: Trinity College Dublin Global Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.coverageDetail: A one-time reduction of EUR 2,000 to EUR 5,000 towards the tuition fees of a full-time postgraduate taught programme, with the amount varying by applicant region
eligibility: Non-EU applicants, including Pakistanis, holding an offer for an eligible full-time postgraduate taught programme at Trinity
Several course areas, including business, engineering, natural sciences, computer science, and statistics, are excluded; check the eligible course list on the scholarship page
Only a limited number of awards are made each year, with selection based on academic excellence
scholarships.deadline: Regional application deadlines apply, typically falling between April and July for September entry; check the current dates on the scholarship page (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for and receive an offer for an eligible full-time postgraduate taught programme at Trinity
Submit the Global Excellence Scholarship application through Trinity's applicant system before the regional deadline

scholarships.name: UCD Global Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.coverageDetail: A limited number of 100% and 50% tuition fee reductions for high-achieving non-EU applicants to full-time undergraduate and graduate taught programmes
eligibility: Non-EU applicants, including Pakistanis, applying for full-time undergraduate or graduate taught programmes at UCD
An excellent academic record, with awards made by UCD's selection panels for each programme area
The scholarship applies to tuition fees only, and the number of awards is limited
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically follow UCD's offer rounds, with deadlines in spring or early summer for September entry (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to a full-time UCD programme and receive an offer
Follow the scholarship application instructions published for your programme on UCD's website

scholarships.name: President's PhD Scholarships at Imperial College London
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition fees for up to 3.5 years of doctoral study, a stipend of GBP 26,500 per year (2026-27 rate), and GBP 2,000 per year for consumables in the early years
eligibility: Applicants of any nationality, including Pakistanis, applying for a full-time PhD at Imperial College London
A first-class UK degree or international equivalent, or an outstanding master's-level qualification
Candidates must hold or be applying for a PhD place at Imperial by the scholarship deadline
scholarships.deadline: Scholarship applications have set deadlines across the admissions cycle, typically from late autumn onwards; check Imperial's scholarship page (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to a full-time PhD programme at Imperial through the online admissions system
Indicate during the PhD application that you wish to be considered for the President's PhD Scholarships and submit by the deadline

scholarships.name: Bocconi Graduate Merit Awards
scholarships.coverageDetail: A 100% waiver on Bocconi's ordinary academic tuition and fees for the entire legal duration of the MSc programme, awarded with first-year admission and renewed subject to merit requirements
eligibility: First-year graduate applicants to Bocconi MSc programmes for the 2026-27 academic year, including international applicants from Pakistan
Selection is based on the admission application dossier; a separate scholarship application is not required
Automatic renewal requires meeting enrolment deadlines and earning at least 50 credits by the start of the second year
scholarships.deadline: Awards are allocated with the admission rounds, with most given in the earliest relevant rounds; check Bocconi's admission round deadlines (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to a Bocconi MSc programme through the online application portal
Complete the online scholarship acceptance procedure by the enrolment deadline if an award is communicated with the admission result

scholarships.name: Vilnius University Tuition Fee Waiver for Master's Students
scholarships.coverageDetail: A full tuition fee waiver awarded to the five most motivated non-EU/EEA applicants to English- or Russian-taught master's programmes; living costs are not covered
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA applicants, including Pakistanis, applying for full-time English- or Russian-taught master's studies at Vilnius University
Motivation demonstrated through the admission interview, as only five waivers are awarded per year
Applicants apply through Vilnius University's central admission system (apply.vu.lt)
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically close around 1 April for the September intake, with motivation interviews held in May (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for a master's programme through apply.vu.lt and tick the tuition fee waiver option in the application
Attend the motivation interview if shortlisted for the waiver

scholarships.name: POSTECH Teaching and Research Assistant Scholarships
scholarships.funder: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Monthly support combining a tuition waiver and a living allowance, totalling around KRW 1,850,000 per month for master's students and KRW 2,200,000 per month for PhD students in 2026, with amounts varying by department and advisor
eligibility: International graduate applicants, including Pakistanis, admitted to POSTECH's master's or PhD programmes
Appointment as a teaching or research assistant under a professor's research programme
Satisfactory academic progress and performance of assistantship duties to maintain the award
scholarships.deadline: POSTECH runs graduate admission rounds for spring and autumn intakes; check the admissions calendar on the POSTECH website (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for POSTECH graduate admission through the online application system
Discuss assistantship funding with the admitting department and advisor, as awards are administered at department level

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarships for Pakistan
scholarships.funder: British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign with participating UK universities
scholarships.coverageDetail: A minimum of GBP 10,000 towards the tuition fees of a one-year taught master's programme at a participating UK university
eligibility: Pakistani passport holders applying for a one-year taught master's at a participating UK university, including universities with dedicated GREAT Scholarships for Pakistan
An offer from a participating university and satisfaction of its entry requirements
Motivation and academic merit as assessed by the participating university
scholarships.deadline: Each participating university sets its own deadline, typically in spring for September entry; check the university's scholarship page (approx.)
howToApply: Choose a participating university from the British Council's GREAT Scholarships list, including the Pakistan-specific slots
Apply directly to the university for admission and follow its scholarship application instructions

scholarships.name: Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (AMS)
scholarships.coverageDetail: A scholarship towards tuition fees for outstanding non-EU/EEA students, with the amount and selection criteria set by each faculty or graduate school
eligibility: Students who hold a non-EU/EEA passport, including Pakistanis, and have applied for a degree programme at the University of Amsterdam
Outstanding academic results in previous education
Applications are submitted to the Admissions Offices of the Graduate Schools, with deadlines differing per faculty
scholarships.deadline: Deadlines differ per faculty or graduate school; check the relevant faculty's scholarship page for the current academic year (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to an eligible University of Amsterdam degree programme first
Submit the Amsterdam Merit Scholarship application to the relevant graduate school's admissions office by its deadline

scholarships.name: University of Twente Scholarship (UTS)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Between EUR 3,000 and EUR 22,000 for one year of a master's programme, with renewal for a second year possible if the scholar averages a 7 out of 10 and completes half of the yearly credits
eligibility: Students from a defined list of eligible countries, which includes Pakistan, applying for a qualifying master's at the University of Twente
Ranking in roughly the best 5-10% of the graduating class, with English results such as IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 90
Not eligible for a Dutch study grant; EU/EEA students and pre-Master and ITC faculty programmes are excluded
scholarships.deadline: The application form typically opens in mid-October and closes on 1 April for the following September intake, with results announced in early May (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for provisional or full admission to a Twente master's programme and receive a student number
Complete the University of Twente Scholarship application form in the student portal before the deadline

scholarships.name: Radboud Scholarship Programme
scholarships.coverageDetail: Reduction of the institutional tuition fee to the Dutch statutory fee level (roughly EUR 2,700 instead of around EUR 18,000) plus coverage of visa, residence permit, and health and liability insurance; living costs are not covered
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA students, including Pakistanis, holding a conditional or unconditional admission offer for an eligible English-taught master's at Radboud University
Strong academic performance making the candidate one of the top applicants for the programme
Compliance with all Dutch visa requirements for study
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically close around 31 January for the September intake (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to an eligible Radboud master's via the university's online application system (OSIRIS)
Indicate interest in the scholarship in the application and submit two reference letters and a CV

scholarships.name: Maastricht University NL-High Potential Scholarship
scholarships.funder: Maastricht University with the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full tuition, a living allowance of EUR 1,550 per month for 13 or 25 months, health and liability insurance, visa expenses, and pre-arrival support to Maastricht; airfare is not included
eligibility: Non-EU/EEA nationals, including Pakistanis, applying for a full-time one- or two-year master's at Maastricht University
Age 35 or younger on 1 September of the intake year and a GPA of at least 7.5 out of 10 (about 75% or a 3.0 out of 4.0)
No previous degree-seeking study in the Netherlands and not already holding another scholarship for the programme
scholarships.deadline: The application window typically runs from October to 1 February for the next academic year, with the master's application completed by early December (approx.)
howToApply: Register for the master's programme in Studielink and complete the faculty application to receive a student ID
Submit the scholarship application in the university portal with a CV, motivation letter, proof of GPA, and references

scholarships.name: VU Fellowship Programme (VUFP)
scholarships.coverageDetail: A merit-based tuition fee waiver for an eligible master's programme; the fellowship does not include a living allowance and can be combined with the NL Scholarship, which contributes towards living costs
eligibility: Students from non-EU/EEA countries who pay the higher institutional tuition fee, including Pakistanis
Applicants holding an offer for an eligible English-taught master's programme at VU Amsterdam
Excellent academic results in previous education
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically close around 1 February for the September intake (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to an eligible VU Amsterdam master's programme
Complete the VUFP scholarship application in the university's portal with the required documents by the deadline

scholarships.name: Leiden Excellence Scholarship (LExS)
scholarships.coverageDetail: Tuition awards of EUR 10,000, EUR 15,000, or the full institutional fee minus the statutory fee, depending on the faculty and award tier; living costs are not covered
eligibility: Students holding non-EU/EEA passports, including Pakistanis, who are not eligible for Dutch study finance
Admission to a full-time master's programme at Leiden University
Excellent academic record; the scholarship can only be combined with certain other awards
scholarships.deadline: For September intake, applications typically close around 1 February; for February intake, around 1 October (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to a Leiden master's programme through the university's online application portal
Indicate interest in the LExS and complete the scholarship application steps in the portal by the deadline

scholarships.name: Tsinghua University Tuition Scholarships for International Graduate Students
scholarships.coverageDetail: Full or partial tuition-fee coverage for prospective full-time international graduate students, for example through the Tsinghua University Tuition Scholarship and the Beijing Government Scholarship
eligibility: Prospective full-time international graduate students at Tsinghua University, including applicants from Pakistan
Applicants to master's or doctoral programmes who request a tuition scholarship as part of the admission application
Awards run for one academic year at a time and must be reapplied for annually on a competitive basis
scholarships.deadline: Scholarship requests follow Tsinghua's graduate admission timeline, which has annual rounds; check the admissions calendar for current deadlines (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to a Tsinghua graduate programme through the online admission system for international students
Request a tuition scholarship during the admission process and reapply each year for continued support

scholarships.name: Reach Oxford Scholarship
scholarships.coverageDetail: University course fees, college fees, a living-costs grant, and one return airfare each year for the duration of an undergraduate degree
eligibility: Nationals of eligible low-income countries, which include Pakistan, who have received an offer for an undergraduate course at Oxford
Applicants must be unable to secure funding for undergraduate study by other means
The scheme considers academic merit and financial need together, with only around two or three awards made each year
scholarships.deadline: Eligible offer-holders are considered through Oxford's undergraduate scholarship process; check the Reach Oxford page for the current application deadline (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for an undergraduate course at Oxford through UCAS by the mid-October deadline
Complete Oxford's scholarship application process for offer-holders to be considered for the Reach Oxford Scholarship

scholarships.name: UCL Global Masters Scholarship
scholarships.coverageDetail: GBP 15,000 towards a full-time master's degree, applied first to fees with any remainder towards maintenance; the amount may be split across two-year programmes
eligibility: Applicants eligible to pay the overseas fee rate, including Pakistanis, from a lower income background
An admission application for a full-time master's at UCL for the current intake; distance-learning programmes are not eligible
Shortlisted candidates must provide evidence of their financial circumstances
scholarships.deadline: The scholarship deadline typically falls in early May, with shortlisting in mid-May and results by late June (approx.)
howToApply: Submit the admission application for a full-time UCL master's programme
Complete the UCL Global Masters Scholarship online application and provide financial evidence if shortlisted

scholarships.name: Developing Solutions Scholarships (University of Nottingham)
scholarships.coverageDetail: 50% or 100% of the tuition fee for a full-time master's programme, depending on the award level granted
eligibility: Applicants domiciled in Africa, India, or selected Commonwealth countries including Pakistan, classed as overseas students for fee purposes
An offer for a full-time master's starting in September in the Faculty of Engineering, Medicine and Health Sciences, Science, or Social Sciences
The scholarship is deducted from the tuition fee and cannot usually be combined with other university scholarships
scholarships.deadline: Applications typically close in spring, with outcomes announced by the end of May for September entry (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for and receive an offer for an eligible full-time master's programme at the University of Nottingham
Submit the Developing Solutions scholarship application through the university's online scholarship system by the deadline

scholarships.name: Eric Bleumink Fund Scholarships
scholarships.coverageDetail: Tuition fees, international travel, subsistence, books, and health insurance for talented students from developing countries taking a master's or PhD programme at the University of Groningen
eligibility: Students from developing countries, including Pakistan, admitted to a University of Groningen master's or PhD programme
Candidates are nominated by the admissions office or faculty; direct applications are not accepted
Master's applicants must have submitted a complete programme application before 1 December
scholarships.deadline: Master's applications should be complete by around 1 December for September intake, with nominations reviewed thereafter (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to a Groningen master's or PhD programme by the required date
Suitable candidates are informed by the Admissions Office if they are being nominated for the fund; no direct application exists

scholarships.name: Charles Wallace Visiting Fellowship Programme (Pakistan)
scholarships.funder: Charles Wallace Pakistan Trust, administered by the British Council
scholarships.coverageDetail: A monthly stipend of GBP 1,600 plus a grant of GBP 1,250 towards travel and visa costs for a short research or professional visit to a UK institution
eligibility: Pakistani nationals currently residing in Pakistan, typically aged between 30 and 55
A written invitation or acceptance from a UK host institution for the planned visit
Mid-career academics, researchers, or professionals with a clear plan for how the visit advances their work in Pakistan
scholarships.deadline: The programme runs periodically, often every other year; check the British Council Pakistan website for the current call (approx.)
howToApply: Secure a written invitation from a UK host institution for the proposed visit
Submit the application through the British Council Pakistan's portal when the call is open, with a CV, visit plan, and host invitation

scholarships.name: Harvard College Financial Aid for International Students
scholarships.coverageDetail: Need-based grant aid meeting 100% of demonstrated financial need; families earning under USD 100,000 typically pay nothing, and aid comes from scholarship grants plus campus employment rather than required loans
eligibility: International applicants, including Pakistanis, admitted to Harvard College's undergraduate programme; admissions are need-blind and aid matches what US students receive
Demonstrated financial need assessed from family financial documents
No merit scholarships exist at Harvard College; aid is awarded solely on the basis of need
scholarships.deadline: Financial aid forms accompany the admission application, with deadlines in early November for early action and early January for regular admission (approx.)
howToApply: Apply for admission to Harvard College through the Common Application or Coalition Application
Submit the required financial aid forms, including the CSS Profile and family income documentation, by the published deadlines
